defmodule FileUpload.RateLimiter do
  use GenServer

  @max_requests_per_window 10
  @window_ms 60_000

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, opts ++ [name: __MODULE__])
  end

  def init(_) do
    {:ok, %{buckets: %{}, cleanup_ref: schedule_cleanup()}}
  end

  def check_rate(user_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:check_rate, user_id})
  end

  def handle_call({:check_rate, user_id}, _from, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    bucket = Map.get(state.buckets, user_id, {0, now})
    {count, window_start} = bucket

    {new_count, new_start, allowed} =
      if now - window_start >= @window_ms do
        {1, now, true}
      else
        if count < @max_requests_per_window do
          {count + 1, window_start, true}
        else
          {count, window_start, false}
        end
      end

    new_buckets = Map.put(state.buckets, user_id, {new_count, new_start})
    {:reply, allowed, %{state | buckets: new_buckets}}
  end

  def handle_info(:cleanup, state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    new_buckets = state.buckets
      |> Enum.reject(fn {_k, {_count, start}} -> now - start > @window_ms * 2 end)
      |> Map.new()
    {:noreply, %{state | buckets: new_buckets, cleanup_ref: schedule_cleanup()}}
  end

  defp schedule_cleanup do
    Process.send_after(self(), :cleanup, @window_ms)
  end
end

defmodule FileUpload.DbDriver do
  @pool_size 5
  @query_timeout 5_000

  def store_upload(user_id, file_data, metadata) do
    conn = checkout_connection()
    try do
      normalized_id = normalize_user_id(user_id)
      execute_insert(conn, normalized_id, file_data, metadata)
    after
      checkin_connection(conn)
    end
  end

  defp normalize_user_id(user_id) when is_binary(user_id) do
    user_id
    |> String.downcase()
    |> String.trim()
  end

  defp normalize_user_id(user_id) when is_integer(user_id) do
    Integer.to_string(user_id)
  end

  defp normalize_user_id(user_id), do: inspect(user_id)

  defp execute_insert(conn, user_id, file_data, metadata) do
    query = "INSERT INTO uploads (user_id, data, metadata, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, NOW())"
    params = [user_id, file_data, Jason.encode!(metadata)]
    execute_query(conn, query, params)
  end

  defp checkout_connection, do: :poolboy.checkout(:db_pool, true, @query_timeout)
  defp checkin_connection(conn), do: :poolboy.checkin(:db_pool, conn)
  defp execute_query(conn, query, params), do: Postgrex.query(conn, query, params, timeout: @query_timeout)
end

defmodule FileUpload.Handler do
  @max_file_size 10_485_760

  def handle_upload(conn, %{"file" => upload, "user_id" => user_id}) do
    with :ok <- validate_file_size(upload),
         :ok <- validate_content_type(upload),
         true <- FileUpload.RateLimiter.check_rate(user_id),
         {:ok, _} <- FileUpload.DbDriver.store_upload(user_id, upload.path |> File.read!(), %{filename: upload.filename, content_type: upload.content_type}) do
      send_resp(conn, 200, "Upload successful")
    else
      false -> send_resp(conn, 429, "Rate limit exceeded")
      {:error, :file_too_large} -> send_resp(conn, 413, "File too large")
      {:error, :invalid_type} -> send_resp(conn, 415, "Invalid file type")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 500, "Internal error: #{inspect(reason)}")
    end
  end

  defp validate_file_size(%{path: path}) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= @max_file_size -> :ok
      {:ok, _} -> {:error, :file_too_large}
      err -> err
    end
  end

  defp validate_content_type(%{content_type: ct}) when ct in ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "application/pdf"], do: :ok
  defp validate_content_type(_), do: {:error, :invalid_type}

  defp send_resp(conn, status, body) do
    %{conn | status: status, resp_body: body}
  end
end
